prose: Eileen Day McKusick returns to talk about her new book, Electric Body, Electric Health. Topics include the human biofield, our electrical plasma body, the rhythms of nature, conjuring appreciation, living from the solar plexus, and untangling the threads of hate.
ext: We expand on how our electric health helps us in an EMF polluted world, the "Sonic Meridian Flush" technique, the "world pain spot" in the biofield, coherent throat chakra expression, and ditching the astral hitchhikers out of our aura.
